title: Tech Note: Introduction to Form Data
author: Timothy Aaron Penner, Senior Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: The new v17 FORM command and formData mechanism described here are still valid, current 4D features for binding an object to a form instance to avoid process-variable juggling across multiple open windows/dialogs. It remains a solid technical description, though the C_Object declaration style is now more commonly written with typed `var` declarations, and later 4D added more object-notation form-scripting patterns since.
related_updates: formData remains a core 4D form concept today
Typed var declarations (v19+) are now preferred over C_Object for new code
ORDA entities are increasingly bound directly to forms alongside/instead of plain formData objects
